question: What conduct should a practitioner abandon after gaining mental equanimity through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equal or balanced mind
Village dharma is named as something to relinquish
The verse gives an injunctive instruction
inference: Through practice one becomes even-minded and should abandon village dharma.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer to conventional social or household duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the dharma of village life.
